observations: Photo shows a disassembled automotive transmission/gearbox unit sitting on a floor among other engine parts and wiring.
Metal casing has visible oil/grease residue and dirt consistent with a used (tokumbo) part.
Various hoses, electrical connectors, and a throttle body are visible nearby but not clearly part of the gearbox itself.
No part number, Toyota/Lexus logo, or stamped plate is legible anywhere on the casing.
Image has a watermark 'SOMTO GREAT' and a timestamp/overlay '2026/10/07 16:07' and 'Shot on POWER70', which are just app artifacts, not proof of anything.
No connector pin count is visible or countable in this shot.

risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being tested on a bench rig or fitted and shifting through gears.

risks.risk: Actual pin count and connector type cannot be confirmed, which affects compatibility across the listed models.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the wiring harness connector showing countable pins.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed compatibility, treated as generic used gearbox core

risks.risk: Claimed compatibility across five different models/trims (Highlander, Venza, RAV4, Camry, RX350, ES350) is unusually broad and may be inaccurate or partially wrong.
risks.proof: A photo of the stamped part/casting number on the gearbox housing, matched against a parts catalog.
risks.if_unproven: priced for narrowest/most common matching model only, not the full list

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood history of the donor vehicle cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle or a teardown/inspection report from a mechanic.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-history used unit, no premium for low mileage

risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible seal/gasket replacement needed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the stamped part/casting number on the gearbox housing
Close-up photo of the wiring connector showing the pin count clearly
Video of the gearbox being bench-tested or shifting through gears
Photo of the donor vehicle (VIN plate or dashboard) to confirm actual source model
Clean photo of the casing seams/seals to check for leaks
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission/gearbox, but none of the seller's specific claims (pin count, exact model fitment, cleanliness, functionality) can be verified from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, unconfirmed-compatibility used core pending the proofs listed.
